For an arithmetic sequence,
\[
a_{15}+a_{24}=(a_1+14d)+(a_1+23d)=2a_1+37d=a_1+a_{38}.
\]
Thus
\[
S_{38}=\frac{38}{2}(a_1+a_{38})=19(a_1+a_{38})=19(a_{15}+a_{24}).
\]
Since \(A,B,C\) are collinear, the coefficients satisfy
\[
a_{15}+a_{24}=1.
\]
Therefore,
\[
S_{38}=19\cdot 1=19.
\]

\boxed{19}
